title: Ordering guarantees O1, O5, O6, O7

behaviour.expect: After trigger(node 1), trigger(node 4) and advance 1000000000, both steps complete at the same virtual time. Either order of the two completions is conforming, but the executor records the order in which they entered the run inbox in the ingestion log, the trace follows exactly that order, and replaying the log reproduces the same trace.

Run with max_cause_depth 10000 and trigger(node 1, 1) once. Handler activations 2..10001 (cause depths 1..10000) each start only after the previous activation has ended (never inside the emitter strand), the host call-stack depth observed at every activation start is the same constant, and the emit in activation 10001, at depth 10000 = max_cause_depth, fails with core/RunawayEventChain (as in G-12).
